PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'if grep -q "✅ ALL_ROUND_COMPLETED" mission.md 2>/dev/null; then echo "🎉 ALL_ROUND_COMPLETED 감지 - OpenCode 루프 종료 준비"; else ROUND=$(grep -o "Round [0-9]*/[0-9]*" mission.md 2>/dev/null | tail -1); NEWS=$(grep "총 뉴스:" mission.md 2>/dev/null | grep -o "[0-9]*" | head -1); echo "📍 현재: ${ROUND:-시작 전} | 📰 뉴스: ${NEWS:-0}개"; fi'
